author: Kushal
problem: There are N keys (up to 15), each real or a dummy. In each of M tests some keys were inserted, and the door opened (o) exactly when at least K of them were real, otherwise it stayed shut (x). Print how many of the 2^N real/dummy assignments agree with every test result.
bug_description: Loops over range(1, 1<<N) instead of range(1<<N), so the assignment where every key is a dummy is never counted.

comments.accurate: Counts the real/dummy key assignments that agree with every test result
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the assignments with at least one real key that agree with every test result
comments.wrong_location: Assignment range verified; check that the bit shift maps key numbers to bits correctly
